title: Exported game crashes, but working in the editor
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: [v4.4.beta2.official](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/a013481b0911e59cc3f3dea7ebb732450c3e1460)
- Not reproducible: [v4.3.stable.official](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/77dcf97d82cbfe4e4615475fa52ca03da645dbd8)

### System information

Windows 11, [v4.4.beta2.official](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/a013481b0911e59cc3f3dea7ebb732450c3e1460)

### Issue description

Just checked my v4.3 project with 4.4 beta 2 on Windows 11.

While the game was running when started from the editor, exporting it to Windows has not been a success. The export process has finished without errors, and I was able to start the game's main menu, however the game itself froze before it produced the following error messages:

```
SCRIPT ERROR: Invalid access to property or key 'resource_path' on a base object of type 'Nil'.

SCRIPT ERROR: Invalid access to property or key 'reach' on a base object of type 'Nil'.
```

Both of these were working when started from the editor, and also back in v4.3, both when exported and in-editor, so there's something wrong with resource handling in 4.4.

Judging from the mentioned 'reach' property, the problematic resource is a custom resource, specific to my game, which is loaded dynamically from a directory under `res:`, and as mentioned, working properly in the editor and in 4.3.

The code which dynamically loads resources is in a "Util" autoload, which contains only static helper functions. The function in question is this:

```gdscript
static func LoadResourcesFromPath(resPath:String, res_extension:String, success_cb:Callable, validator_cb=null):
	assert(validator_cb == null or validator_cb is Callable)
	var dir := DirAccess.open(resPath)
	if dir:
		dir.list_dir_begin()
		var file_name := dir.get_next()
		while file_name != "":
			if file_name.ends_with(res_extension):
				var entry:Resource = load("%s/%s" % [resPath, file_name])
				if validator_cb is Callable:
					if not validator_cb.call(entry, file_name):
						printerr("Loaded resource failed validation: %s :: %s" % [entry, file_name])
						breakpoint
				success_cb.call(entry)
			file_name = dir.get_next()
	else:
		printerr("Util.LoadResourcesFromPath cannot open %s" % resPath)
```

I see no error messages reported by this function, not even when the exported game hangs.

### Steps to reproduce

I merely opened the project in 4.4 beta 2 which was working fine in v4.3.
